mapper.select: select resource_id, media_id, group_name, platform, url, pwd, group_order, source, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from km_media_resource where media_id = #{mediaId} order by group_order asc, resource_id asc
mapper.delete: delete from km_media_resource where media_id = #{mediaId} and source = #{source}
mapper.update: update km_media_resource set group_name = #{groupName}, platform = #{platform}, url = #{url}, pwd = #{pwd}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where resource_id = #{resourceId}
